resume: Eight-voice analog-style polysynth, in the spirit of the American polys of 1979 to 1984. Four tracks, each with its own sound, arpeggiator and sequence, go through a mixer (chorus, delay, plate reverb, drive) and a MASTER (DJ filter, drive, compressor).

commandes.role: Octave down; with OCT+, back to 0. With EDIT, undo.
Octave up; with OCT-, back to 0. With EDIT, redo.
Tapped: CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB, DRIVE. Held: effects layer, the keys play notes (KNOB 1 to 4: chorus, delay, reverb, delay time).
Tapped: OSC and FILTER pages; in STEPS, clears the step. Held: erases the played note.
Tapped: GLOBAL, VOICE, OUTPUT. Held: the white keys start, mute or solo tracks A to D.
PERFORM page (CUTOFF, RESO, ENV AMT, RELEASE); again, the MIXER.
Twice: saves the track's program. Held: goes to a pattern (white keys 1 to 8) or copies it (black keys).
Arpeggiator page; on this page, ARP becomes HOLD.
Tapped: full-screen sequencer, then its views (TRACKS, STEPS, TRACK, PATTERNS). Held: the keys are the steps.
Starts the active tracks from step 1, or stops them.
During playback, records the selected track; when stopped, arms (the first note starts). Held 1.2 s: clears the track.
Tempo; in the sequencer and mixer, the next pattern (on the bar).
Selects the track, A to D.
They play the selected track's sound.

a_savoir: The eight voices are shared among the four tracks.
